entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Quarantine Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.E2ETest.ServerExecutionTests.ServerEventTest.PreventDefault_DotNotApplyByDefault #62533
  • devserver needs to implement Posix signal handling #62528
  • Blazor logging scopes #62527
  • Use IStructurallyEqual in ChangeDetection #62523
  • Allow disabling static assets compression for specific files #62522
  • NavigationManager.NavigateTo has no effect if called after a aynchronous method in OnIntializedAsync, in SSR mode #62519
  • [OpenApi] FromForm parameters with [Description] Attribute not include the description text #62514
  • Why do a large number of API interfaces occasionally respond slowly? #62513

Closed

  • Perf regression: json, tls-renegotiation-kestrel #62468
